title: Piano High Score
description:
⚠️ Requires a digital piano or MIDI keyboard.

Just play.

Piano High Score is a pure, arcade-style rhythm game for digital pianos and MIDI keyboards. Jump in with included songs or load your own MIDI files, press play, and perform as notes fall toward the hit line, scored by timing, accuracy, and combo streaks.

No accounts. No tools. No subscriptions.

Fast to start, satisfying to master, and built for one-more-run high-score chasing.

Features:

• Load your own MIDI files (drag and drop supported)

• Works with digital pianos and MIDI keyboards

• Tight timing-based scoring with combos

• Practice mode for focused improvement

• Per-song global and Friends leaderboards

Skip the lesson. Chase the score.
description_short: Everything you love about rhythm games, brought to your digital piano. Load your own MIDI files, play on real keys, and climb online leaderboards.
